prompts:
Tidewater Studio is announcing its balloon launch. Two small jobs before the post goes out:

1. `launch.jpg` becomes the feed picture: a 1080x1350 JPEG at `out/feed-photo.jpg`. The magenta balloon is the
   subject, so it has to be fully in the picture and still look like itself.
2. The park's permit form `permit-form.pdf` filled in with the details Ines sent in `event-details.txt`, saved at
   `out/permit-filled.pdf` and flattened, so the answers can no longer be edited.

Keep the originals as they are.
answers:
[goal] Produce `out/feed-photo.jpg` (1080x1350) and flattened `out/permit-filled.pdf`; leave originals untouched.

[action] Feed photo: cropped the right 1600x2000 px (x 1400-3000) of the 3000x2000 original, keeping full height, then uniform Lanczos resize to 1080x1350, JPEG q95, 4:4:4, sRGB. Crop anchored to the right edge so the magenta balloon has 168 px clearance on its right and remains complete. Permit: filled the four fields (`Tidewater Studio`, `2026-12-05`, `North Cove Lawn`, `about 40`), then PyMuPDF `bake(widgets=True)` to convert appearances to page content.

[result] Image verified: JPEG, 1080x1350, RGB; magenta subject bbox x 641-911, y 338-607 with margins 641/338/168/742, no clipping; single uniform scale, no distortion. PDF verified: 1 page, 595x842, `WIDGETS []`, `IS_FORM False`, no `/AcroForm` or `/Widget`, extracted text contains all four answers. Originals unchanged (sizes and read-only processing; SHA-256 `DB8AA0...D640` for launch.jpg, `F45568...584625` for permit-form.pdf). Assumptions: date entered in the form's requested `YYYY-MM-DD` format (`2026-12-05`); attendance kept verbatim as "about 40"; crop rather than generative outpainting, since cropping alone keeps the subject intact.
